CustomField.description: Unchecked = the tag is kept for history (its existing assignments stay) but can no longer be applied: Tag Manager hides it and the Tag_Must_Be_Active rule on Tag Assignment blocks new assignments. eTapestry groups that were disabled in eTap migrate as inactive tags. Jason Ott, 2026-11-16.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to retire this tag. Records that already have it keep it; it can no longer be added to records.
CustomField.label: Active
